title: Retire the oldest month of event history: READ-ONLY on QA (summary, unknown retirement, refusals)
description: The platform administrator reads the retention summary (200, the time it was computed, the number of tenant schemas and of protected records), and is answered 404 for a retirement id that does not exist. A company administrator is refused the summary, the start of a retirement and the read of a retirement with the same fixed 403; a caller without a sign-in gets 401. NOT automated, on purpose: the real start (POST /api/v1/event-retention/retirements) retires the oldest eligible month of the event history of EVERY tenant and it cannot be undone by a script (the month is computed by the system, never supplied, so the runner cannot choose a harmless one); the start, the follow-up of its per-tenant outcomes and the 409 'no eligible month' are covered by test/letflow/routers/event_retention_test.exs. GAP (not invented): the screen EventRetentionPage has no web test and is not run here (screen only). Nothing is created or changed, so there is nothing to clean up and no residue; the fixture tenant is not needed.

steps.says: The operator reads the retention summary: 200 with the time it was computed and the two counts. The oldest eligible month may be empty, so it is only remembered when there is one.
A retirement id nobody ever started: 404 (a fresh random id).
A company administrator is refused the summary with the fixed 403.
A company administrator may not START a retirement: refused before anything runs (no body on purpose; nothing can start).
A company administrator asking for a retirement id gets the same 403 as for the summary.
Without a sign-in the summary is refused: 401.
